properties.question: What is the SmartSaver Account?
properties.answer_summary: easy-access savings account that earns variable interest with no penalties or waiting periods on deposits and withdrawals; designed for customers seeking flexible savings with competitive rates

properties.question: Who can open a SmartSaver Account?
properties.answer_summary: applicants must be at least 18 years old, UK residents, able to provide UK Passport or Driving License, and able to provide proof of address

properties.question: Is there a minimum balance requirement?
properties.answer_summary: no minimum balance required; account can be opened with £1.00 and no minimum balance needed to keep account open

properties.question: How do I open a SmartSaver Account?
properties.answer_summary: account can be opened online via www.firstuk.bank, in any FirstUK Bank branch, or by post via application pack requested at 0800-555-2265

properties.question: How long does it take to open an account?
properties.answer_summary: online or branch opening takes 1–2 business days; postal opening takes 5–7 business days

properties.question: What interest rate do I earn?
properties.answer_summary: Interest rate depends on account balance: £0–£10,000 earns 4.50% AER; £10,001–£50,000 earns 4.70% AER; £50,001+ earns 4.80% AER

properties.question: Is the interest rate fixed or variable?
properties.answer_summary: The rate is variable and changes monthly based on Bank of England base rate. Rate rises if BoE raises rates; rate falls if BoE cuts rates.

properties.question: How is interest calculated and paid?
properties.answer_summary: Interest is calculated daily (accrues every day) and paid monthly on the last business day of the month. Example: £10,000 at 4.50% earns about £37.50 per month.

properties.question: Can my interest rate decrease?
properties.answer_summary: Yes. If the Bank of England cuts its base rate, the account rate will decrease. The bank's margin of 2.50% remains constant.

properties.question: When will my rate next change?
properties.answer_summary: Rates are reviewed monthly, typically mid-month. If there is a change, it becomes effective on the 1st of the following month. Customer is notified by email if rate changes.

properties.question: What if I don't like the new interest rate?
properties.answer_summary: Customer can keep the account and accept the new rate, switch to SmartSaver Plus (if balance exceeds £50,000), close the account without penalties, or switch to a current account or other product.
properties.customer_action: Choose to accept new rate, switch products, or close account
